constraints.description: The accepted nested frontend lock is accepted unchanged by pnpm 11.15.0 frozen metadata-only and empty-dependency-tree installation for the exact source and submodule pin.

validation.validation_method: Pre/post nested and root SHA-256 comparison around both frozen installation commands

constraints.description: The stale committed nested lock is retained as a negative control that exits non-zero and identifies the entity-management importer mismatch.

validation.validation_method: Clean 1274039a frozen nested-install failure receipt with command, output, exit status, and unchanged digest

constraints.description: The nested lock repair preserves unrelated common package and snapshot bodies while retaining only manifest-caused importer and peer-context movement.

validation.validation_method: Two independent regeneration digests, direct HEAD parser audit, restored common bodies, and frozen acceptance

constraints.description: The child changes only the nested frontend lock and permitted OpenSpec, KBD, refiner, canonical-spec, and append-only history artifacts; manifests, product code, root lock, gitlink, generated output, parent evidence, settings, and refiner registry remain excluded.

validation.validation_method: Immutable-input hashes, gitlink replay, scoped status, explicit exclusion inventory, staged-name audit, and git diff check

constraints.description: Per-requirement evidence records actual commands, observed outputs, and limits without claiming parent browser certification, runtime behavior, install scripts, release readiness, or cross-platform transfer.

validation.validation_method: Verification-row audit, strict OpenSpec, artifact schemas, referenced-file existence, hashes, and independent artifact-only review

global_rules: Use the child OpenSpec proposal, delta, tasks, KBD plan, and scope as acceptance authority.
Do not accept optional allowed-range movements merely because two clean resolver runs agree.
Do not stage operator settings, root pnpm-lock.yaml, product source, static output, parent screen evidence, prior bundles, or .refiner/registry.json.
Do not claim parent browser certification or release readiness from dependency installation and focused frontend checks.
termination_conditions: Manifest, constraints, state, checkpoint, reference, hash, strict OpenSpec, and scoped diff checks pass.
History-free artifact critic and judge find no implementation, scope, or evidence blocker.
